  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.06</span>
    <span>Embeddings</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models</h3>
  <p>This paper introduces Qwen3 Embedding, a family of text embedding and reranking models built on Qwen3 foundation models with a multi-stage training pipeline, model merging, and LLM-synthesized multilingual data. The series covers 0.6B, 4B, and 8B sizes and achieves state-of-the-art results across multilingual embedding, retrieval, reranking, code retrieval, and cross-lingual benchmarks.</p>

<article class="paper-card" id="coquir-a-comprehensive-benchmark-for-code-quality-aware-information-retrieval">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.05</span>
    <span>Embeddings</span>
  </div>
  <h3>CoQuIR: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Code Quality-Aware Information Retrieval</h3>
  <p>This paper introduces CoQuIR, the first large-scale multilingual benchmark for quality-aware code retrieval, with 42,725 queries and 134,907 snippets annotated for correctness, efficiency, security, and maintainability. Its two quality-centric metrics and evaluation of 23 retrievers expose major quality-awareness gaps, while contrastive training improves quality-aware retrieval without sacrificing semantic relevance.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
